verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs include a dedicated prompt caching page. It explains that requests sharing the same prefix reuse previously computed tokens, that cached tokens are billed at 10% of the standard input price, and that cache hits can reduce latency. This covers mechanism, cost, and latency. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the savings, and evidence of cache details such as TTL or minimum prefix size.
